title: Derived square vertical pasting
statement: For schemes [def-pc-scheme] with their shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], write $F_r=Lr^*$ and $c(r,s):F_rF_s\cong F_{r s}$ for the selected composition comparison [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Define the square comparison $D(p,p_1,t,a)=c(p_1,t)\gg \mathrm{transport}\gg c(a,p)^{-1}$ as in [lem-pc-scheme-derived-mate-evaluation]. Let $p:A\to W$, $p_1:B\to T$, $p_2:C\to T\prime$, $t:T\to W$, $i:T\prime\to T$, $t\prime:T\prime\to W$, $a:B\to A$, $b:C\to B$, $a\prime:C\to A$ satisfy $ap=p_1t$, $bp_1=p_2i$, $a\prime p=p_2t\prime$, $it=t\prime$ and $ba=a\prime$. For every $E$ in the derived category of $W$, the following equality holds (composition written in Lean order): $D(p_1,p_2,i,b)_{F_tE}\gg F_b(D(p,p_1,t,a)_E)\gg c(b,a)_{F_pE}\gg\mathrm{transport}_{ba=a\prime}=F_{p_2}((c(i,t)\gg\mathrm{transport}_{it=t\prime})_E)\gg D(p,p_2,t\prime,a\prime)_E$. No cartesianness, direct-image adjunction, coefficient module, or invertibility of a single-module comparison is assumed.

proof.text: Expand the square comparisons. Substitute tprime = i followed by t and aprime = b followed by a. Evaluate the selected composition associativity equations for b,p1,t, for p2,i,t, and for b,a,p. Naturality of equality transport for the composition comparison moves the equalities ha and hb between these equations. Postcompose by the invertible double-composition comparison and cancel hom/inv pairs. The equality transports compose and proof irrelevance identifies them with the outer square equality ha-prime. Use Iso.eq_comp_inv to remove the inverse final composition comparison and reassociate. This proves the displayed equality without any base-change mate or coefficient hypothesis.

lean.statement: theorem canonicalDerivedSquareComparison_vertical {A B C W T T' : Scheme.{v}} (p : A ⟶ W) (p1 : B ⟶ T) (p2 : C ⟶ T') (t : T ⟶ W) (i : T' ⟶ T) (t' : T' ⟶ W) (a : B ⟶ A) (b : C ⟶ B) (a' : C ⟶ A) (ha : a ≫ p = p1 ≫ t) (hb : b ≫ p1 = p2 ≫ i) (ha' : a' ≫ p = p2 ≫ t') (h : i ≫ t = t') (hab : b ≫ a = a') (E : schemeDerivedCategory W) : canonicalDerivedSquareComparison p1 p2 i b hb ((derivedPullback t).obj E) ≫ (derivedPullback b).map (canonicalDerivedSquareComparison p p1 t a ha E) ≫ (canonicalDerivedPullbackComposition b a ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun q ↦ derivedPullback q) hab)).hom.app ((derivedPullback p).obj E) = (derivedPullback p2).map ((canonicalDerivedPullbackComposition i t ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun q ↦ derivedPullback q) h)).hom.app E) ≫ canonicalDerivedSquareComparison p p2 t' a' ha' E
